# Athreya M R

> Front-end Architect in Bangalore. Personal site: https://athreya.codes

Athreya M R is a Front-end Architect in Bangalore, India, with 11+ years building enterprise Angular applications. He is a Senior Software Engineer at Mimecast, working on a next-generation email security platform with Angular, micro frontends, and an Nx monorepo.

Previously Product Engineer at Enate Technologies (2019–2024), leading a front-end team on a micro-frontend product, and Software Engineer at Mphasis (2015–2019) building Angular apps for FedEx.

## Skills

- Angular, TypeScript
- Micro frontends, Module Federation, Nx monorepos
- SSR/SSG, technical SEO, web performance, accessibility
- Design systems
- AI-enabled fullstack delivery
